replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Sorry, but your map has been denied.

The map itself is just a smaller version of Quintus and it's using a different color pallete. I don't think it'll play good, and it looks just... too basic.
You're free to resubmit your map whenever you feel like it. Thanks!

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Too plain. How could you make it look more appealing?
→ Too flat. Could you improve it with terrain or structures?
→ Thin lanes. Could these be expanded and given more width?
→ Lacks creativity. Is there a map already like this? Is it unique?
→ Blocky. Do you think you could shape the map better?
